description: Resource Type definition for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentOrganizationalProfile. An Agent Organizational Profile is an Agent Profile scoped to an AWS Organization; the organization is inferred from the caller's identity, and the profile does not carry a single-account execution role or aggregation configuration. Only usable in the AWS Organizations management or delegated-admin account.

Pillar.description: A Well-Architected pillar the Agent Organizational Profile focuses on.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with the Agent Organizational Profile.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Organizational Profile.

Name.description: The name of the organizational profile. Unique within the account and used as the last component of the ARN.

DisplayName.description: The human-readable display name of the organizational profile.

Description.description: A description of the organizational profile.

BusinessOverview.description: A business overview for the organizational profile used to improve recommendation quality.

Pillars.description: The list of Well-Architected pillars to focus on.

DeletionProtection.description: Whether deletion protection is enabled for the organizational profile. When enabled, the profile cannot be deleted until deletion protection is disabled.

Tags.description: Key-value pairs to associate with the Agent Organizational Profile.

CreatedBy.description: The identifier of the system or user that created this organizational profile.

CreatedAt.description: The timestamp when the organizational profile was created.

LastModifiedBy.description: The identifier of the system or user that last modified this organizational profile.

LastModifiedAt.description: The timestamp when the organizational profile was last modified.
